messages:
maria_ae: Quick heads-up — Nimbus POC ramped to ~30 rps and reporting slow first-token (TTFT ~600–800ms) and intermittent 429s when burst hits. Customer on a call in 30m. Can we swarm?
jamie_se: Thanks. Do we have a request_id or example request logs from them? model name? seq len distribution?
maria_ae: They sent a couple request_ids in the email: req=nx-9a7 and req=nx-9b0. Model is gpt-open-v1 (seqs mostly 120–350 tokens). They said they enabled prefill=true in their client.
suresh_oncall: @jamie_se grabbing logs now. Seeing req=nx-9a7 429s from edge -> our upstream token-bucket. Early token lag looks correlated with batching window spikes. Pasting small log slice:
```
[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] req=nx-9a7 route=prod-eu model=gpt-open-v1 seq=240 batch_id=487 in_flight=12 kv_cache_miss=true first_token_ms=742
[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] req=nx-9a7 429 reason=concurrency_limit throttled_pool=general_gpu
```
cole_support: Kv_cache_miss=true is suspicious — are they using per-request new prompts or varying system messages? Misses will force full decode and slow TTFT.
ingrid_eng: Also seeing spikes in batching.window_ms: default was 50ms but effective window expanded to 120ms under load due to queueing. That increases latency.
maria_ae: Customer says they send lots of short prefaces and then long completions — they thought prefill=true would help but maybe it's interacting badly with batching.
jamie_se: Quick mitigation checklist for call: 1) ask them to set batching.window_ms=10 (or disable batching for warmup) 2) enable KV prefill: prefill.tokens=8 3) temporarily increase concurrency_limit for the dedicated pool or bump to burst credits 4) pin model variant to the lower-latency quantized variant.
neha_security: Any changes that touch KV prefill or caching — confirm no PII gets persisted in cache. Need their data retention request for contract.
customer_cto: We can scrub PII on our side. For the test we can send sanitized prompts. Pricing question: if we need burst capacity for a 2-hour demo, what are options?
maria_ae: Sales: short-term burst add-on or a one-off invoiceable burst at negotiated rate. I can loop finance.
suresh_oncall: From infra side — immediate quick fix we can do during call: flip routing to a dedicated burst pool for that org (if available) and temporarily relax concurrency checks for their tenant id. That will drop 429s but will increase cost.
cole_support: Also recommend turning off prefill=true if they are using it incorrectly — prefill helps if you prefill KV with repeated context; if every request has unique context it creates extra overhead.
jamie_se: For reproducible reproducer ask them to run this curl and paste response headers:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-v1","input":"<sanitized>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Look for x-rw-ttft, x-rw-batch-id, x-rw-cache-status.
ops_bot: [deploy-notif] canary rollout for kernel-hotfix completed in us-west at 13:45 UTC :white_check_mark:
ingsrid_eng: Typo in channel name ^ — also note kernel-hotfix reduced tail-latency for >512 seqs, but this POC is in eu; hotfix not rolled there yet.
suresh_oncall: Rolling the kernel patch to eu as hotfix now — ETA ~12 minutes. Will also push a conservative change: reduce batching.max_window_ms to 30 for prod-eu.
customer_cto: Appreciate it. We'll try the smaller window and scrubbed prefill toggle during the call.
jamie_se: Post-call actions (we'll own): 1) collect curl headers + 2 sample req_ids 2) try batching.window_ms=10 and prefill.tokens=8 toggles 3) if 429s persist, route to burst pool and raise concurrency for 1h 4) finance to propose one-off burst pricing for demo.
neha_security: I'll send a short checklist about cache encryption and retention to the customer — confirm they accept.
maria_ae: Thanks all — joining the call now. Will paste results and req_ids back here after test. :thumbsup:
(--- 30 minutes later)
maria_ae: Update from call — after reducing batching.window_ms to 10 and enabling prefill.tokens=8 TTFT dropped to ~160–220ms and 429s stopped. Customer asked for best-practice doc for warmup + prefill.
jamie_se: Great. I'll draft a short KB: "Warmup & prefill playbook" with recommended defaults (batching.window_ms=10 for bursty rps, prefill.tokens=6–12, pin quantized variant, reserve small burst pool).
cole_support: Marking thread for follow-up: add replicable test script + the curl reproducer to support repo.
maria_ae: Also confirmed they want a 2-hour demo burst — sending to finance. Good job! :tada:
